title: Target one Claude Code harness per project instead of writing bridges unconditionally
description: opum-agent OPAG-41 requires this repo file its half of the upstream fix before AGENTS.md can be deleted fleet-wide: lore init and lore agents write Claude, Codex and AGENTS.md bridges unconditionally rather than targeting one harness per project, and skills should distribute via the marketplace (the opum-lore plugin, LCLI-441) while init primes only the CLAUDE.md block. This also relates to LCLI-437 (agents --check drift on a Codex-only init) and is the concrete blocker recorded on LCLI-439/LCLI-438: this repo cannot delete its own AGENTS.md or .codex/ until this lands, because AGENTS.md is currently the only home for the Quest-managed instructions block (quest agents --check --require-installed reads it there) and the only Codex-bridge selection signal lore agents --check inspects.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore init defaults to one selected harness (Claude or Codex) rather than writing both bridges unconditionally
lore agents --check reports a consistent result for a Claude-only, a Codex-only, and a both-bridges repository without requiring the unselected bridge
Once this lands, lore-cli AGENTS.md and .codex/ can be deleted without breaking quest agents --check --require-installed or lore agent-bridge product behavior
